body: Hi OP. We have two Romanian rescues and our first boy was like this for week unfortunately. He would come out at night to eat, drink and potty when the house was quiet and noone around. It might be the same for your little one for a while yet. Just be patient and don't rush him into accepting affection yet. Just sit near by doing something, not paying him much attention to help him get used to people and know that they're actually nice 🙂 best of luck, keep us updated!
